environment.mode: Headless Chromium with HTML supplied through page.set_content; environment policy blocks file and loopback navigation

checks.check: Self-contained HTML initializes when supplied directly to the browser
Blank state does not invent a plan or result
First keyboard stop is the skip link
Skip link moves focus to the main content
Every form control has an associated label
Every described-by reference exists
No duplicate HTML IDs
No positive tabindex overrides keyboard order
Routine feedback has a status live region
Required fields are validated without creating a plan
Validation errors receive keyboard focus
Error links move focus to the relevant control
Observation is rejected without a plan
Example is explicitly illustrative, not a claimed real result
Saving a snapshot creates one plan and no fake outcome
Unconfirmed required support is not treated as available
Readiness alone does not override unconfirmed support
Confirmed support still carries an independent-verification qualification
Contradictory required-support fields are flagged
Unavailable support is not counted as opportunity
Choosing to pause is preserved, not ranked as failure
An observation cannot silently attach to an outdated snapshot
Observation references its exact plan snapshot
Earlier plan snapshots are preserved
JSON export includes unsaved plan and observation drafts
JSON export preserves all snapshots and linked observations
Readable text export includes current draft, history, and unverified-data limits
Clear resets the open journal and form after confirmation
Import round-trip restores current draft and history
Import restores unfinished observation draft
Malformed JSON is rejected without overwriting current work
Broken provenance references are rejected atomically
Impossible imported calendar dates are rejected
Unknown schema versions are rejected
Oversized files are rejected before parsing
Imported text fields enforce length bounds
Imported markup is rendered as literal text, not HTML
No application HTTP/WebSocket requests occurred during the tested workflow
App source has no browser-storage calls and no cookies were created
Content Security Policy explicitly blocks network connections
The tested screen fits a 320 CSS-pixel viewport without horizontal overflow
No uncaught JavaScript errors occurred
No browser console errors occurred in the tested workflow

limits: No real person or service-provider pilot was performed.
No JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver, or other actual screen-reader session was run.
No full WCAG conformance audit or independent security audit was performed.
No real-world opportunity, income, housing, health, or employment result is claimed.
Only the included browser workflows and fixtures were tested.

Direct file:// and loopback-HTTP launch were blocked by test-environment policy. Browser checks supplied the identical self-contained HTML through page.set_content; direct local-file launch remains unverified.
